item.title: Women's HIL 2025-26: Ranchi Royals Enjoy Dominant 5-0 Win Over Shrachi Bengal Tigers
item.description: Ranchi Royals enjoyed a comfortable 5-0 victory over Shrachi Bengal Tigers in their second match of the Women's Hockey India League (HIL) 2025-26 Season at the Marang Gomke Jaipal Singh Munda Astro Turf Stadium in Ranchi on Tuesday. Lucina von der Heyde (33',57'), Hannah Cotter (10'), Beauty Dungdung (14'), and Sangita Kumari (44') registered goals for Ranchi Royals.

item.title: Football: Elche's Barcelona Loanee Hector Fort Sidelined After Shoulder Operation
item.description: Hector Fort: Elche defender Hector Fort has undergone an operation on a dislocated left shoulder, the club has confirmed. The 19-year-old, who is on loan from FC Barcelona with the recently promoted club, suffered the injury as he scored the opening goal in Elche's 4-0 win at home to Rayo Vallecano on December 21.

item.description: Newcastle United Newcastle United: Wolverhampton Wanderers halted a run of 11 straight Premier League defeats with a hard-earned 1-1 draw against Manchester United.

item.title: Desert Vipers Storm into ILT20 Final After Crushing MI Emirates by 45 Runs
item.description: Andries Gous’ record-breaking unbeaten century powered Desert Vipers to a dominant 45-run win over MI Emirates in Qualifier 1, sealing their third DP World ILT20 final appearance in four seasons.

item.title: Premier League: Arsenal Thrash Villa To End Year 5 Points Clear At The Top
item.description: Although Nuno Espirito Santo: Arsenal ended the year on top of the Premier League table after an outstanding second-half showing saw the Gunners cruise past third-placed Aston Villa 4-1.

item.title: Ex-Aussie Batter Damien Martyn In Induced Coma After Meningitis Diagnosis
item.description: The Sydney Morning Herald: Former Aussie batter Damien Martyn is in an induced coma after being diagnosed with meningitis. The 54-year-old former batter, who played 67 Test matches between 1992 and 2006, reportedly fell ill on Friday and was rushed to the hospital.

item.title: Premier League: Chelsea Held By Bournemouth 2-2
item.description: Premier League: Chelsea and AFC Bournemouth played out an enthralling 2-2 draw at Stamford Bridge, with all four goals being scored inside the opening 27 minutes.

item.title: Asian Games Will Be The Biggest Challenge For India In 2026
item.description: Summer World University Games: After a successful 2025 in which Indian sportspersons shone bright in many events on the global stage, the year 2026 heralds fresher and tougher challenges, and top-most on the radar is the 20th edition of the Asian Games to be held in Aichi Prefecture and Nagoya in Japan from September 19 to October 4, 2026.
